newsitem.title: USA: Sepragen expects to be delisted by Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Sepragen expects to be delisted by Nasdaq.

text.p: Sepragen Corp said Tuesday that it expects to be delisted by the Nasdaq stock exchange.

It said in a statement Nasdaq had informed it that because the company does not meet minimum net assets requirements and shareholders' equity of at least $2 million and $1 million, respectively, Nasdaq plans to delist the stock on June 20.
A company spokesman said Sepragen is contemplating seeking a hearing with Nasdaq which might delay the delisting.
It found itself in this situation because it has not been allowed to close escrow on money collected in its financing due to circumstances beyond its control.
Sepragen SPN.P said it is still listed on the Pacific Stock Exchange and is pursuing other investment and corporate alliances to raise more capital.
